svg.desc: and: sift 19,332, sift (positions off) 22,821, pg_search 2,312, pg_textsearch 148, rum 4,472, pgx-bm25 164, Elasticsearch 10,756; or: sift 6,208, sift (positions off) 7,146, pg_search 1,658, pg_textsearch 8,309, rum 42, pgx-bm25 128, Elasticsearch 7,602; phrase: sift 17,338, sift (positions off) 5,388, pg_search 1,918, pg_textsearch 138, rum 137, pgx-bm25 93, Elasticsearch 11,747; mixed: sift 10,623, sift (positions off) 6,905, pg_search 1,825, pg_textsearch 99, rum 67, pgx-bm25 125, Elasticsearch 10,219; count(*): sift 22,749, sift (positions off) 5,583, pg_search 1,744, pg_textsearch 149, rum 209, pgx-bm25 123, Elasticsearch 24,951; filter: sift 12,075, sift (positions off) 9,381, pg_search 1,874, pg_textsearch 131, rum 83, pgx-bm25 130, Elasticsearch 14,443; join: sift 5,323, sift (positions off) 3,158, pg_search 388, pg_textsearch 153, rum 94, pgx-bm25 141, Elasticsearch 16,433
svg.text: queries per second, higher is better
Error bars: one standard error over the interleaved rounds (rough for 2-3); red: relative error above 10%.
Elasticsearch: a JVM server over HTTP; its join is a term filter on a denormalized region field.
Simple English Wikipedia, 50,000 articles, 8 clients, median of 2-3 rounds; AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads (load avg 12-18); Oct 2026.
